premises.statement: Finite normalization of a locally algebraic scheme over a field; reduced integral schemes have finite birational normalization.
premises.hypotheses_and_application: n1 curve normalization; n2 integral h and finite R[h].

premises.statement: A Noetherian normal domain equals the intersection of its height-one localizations.
premises.hypotheses_and_application: n2 integrality from all height-one bounds.

premises.statement: A one-dimensional Noetherian normal local domain is a DVR, equivalently regular local of dimension one.
premises.hypotheses_and_application: n1 curve local rings; n2 height-one valuations.

premises.statement: In a Noetherian ring, a prime minimal over r equations has height at most r.
premises.hypotheses_and_application: n1 every reduced slice component is horizontal.

premises.statement: For an injective finite-type map of Noetherian domains the dimension inequality holds, with equality over a universally catenary base; apply to a field.
premises.hypotheses_and_application: n1 slice component dimension, retaining the field/domain hypotheses.

premises.statement: For a curve, normality at a closed point is equivalent to a DVR; over a perfect field it is equivalent to smoothness.
A nonconstant morphism of curves with normal target is flat, by torsion freeness over a DVR.
premises.hypotheses_and_application: n1 normalized finite curve cover has rank d.

premises.statement: A rational relative morphism from a Noetherian reduced curve extends at a valuation local ring when its target is proper over the SAME base scheme; uniqueness is separatedness.
premises.hypotheses_and_application: n1 proper lift to the original witness; the witness need not be proper over F.

premises.statement: Projection from a point outside a closed projective subscheme is finite, retaining projectivity and avoidance of that subscheme.
Secant and tangent avoidance gives a local isomorphism under finite projection at a smooth point when the subvariety dimension is below ambient dimension minus one.
premises.hypotheses_and_application: n3 proof prototype; reduced-union extension is proved by local Nakayama rather than asserted from this statement.

premises.statement: A scheme locally of finite type over a field is Jacobson; closed residue fields are algebraic over that field.
premises.hypotheses_and_application: n3 closed-point affine cover covers every scheme and analytic point.

premises.statement: For a reduced locally algebraic scheme over a perfect field, its regular locus is its dense open smooth locus.
premises.hypotheses_and_application: n3 successive reduced singular strata strictly drop dimension.

premises.statement: Thuillier 3.1.9: a subharmonic function on a neighborhood of a connected strictly affinoid curve domain has finite values on its Shilov boundary.
premises.hypotheses_and_application: n1 finite-value strict-disc radial comparison; the identically-minus-infinity alternative is handled separately by usc.
